description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token used to ensure idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. The value must be unique across different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

descriptions.zh:
调用此接口时，请注意：

- 如果词典文件来源于OSS，需要确保OSS存储空间为公共可读。
- 如果已经上传的词典不加ORIGIN配置，调用此接口后，词典文件会被删除。
descriptions.en:
When calling this operation, note the following:

- If the dictionary file is sourced from OSS, make sure the OSS bucket has public-read permission.
- If a previously uploaded dictionary is not configured with ORIGIN, the dictionary file will be deleted after this operation is called.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch update-synonyms-dicts --instance-id es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --biz-body example-string --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
